meta.name: Loki 2021
meta.description: After stealing the Tesseract during the events of “Avengers: Endgame,” an alternate version of Loki is brought to the mysterious Time Variance Authority, a bureaucratic organization that exists outside of time and space and monitors the timeline. They give Loki a choice: face being erased from existence due to being a “time variant” or help fix the timeline and stop a greater threat.

videos.title: Glorious Purpose
videos.overview: After stealing the Tesseract in "Avengers: Endgame," Loki lands before the Time Variance Authority.

videos.title: The Variant
videos.overview: Mobius puts Loki to work, but not everyone at TVA is thrilled about the God of Mischief's presence.

videos.title: Lamentis
videos.overview: Loki finds out The Variant's plans, but he has his own that will forever alter both their destinies.

videos.title: The Nexus Event
videos.overview: Frayed nerves and paranoia infiltrate the TVA as Mobius and Hunter B-15 search for Loki and Sylvie.

videos.title: Journey into Mystery
videos.overview: Loki tries to escape The Void, a desolate purgatory where he meets variant versions of himself.

videos.title: For All Time. Always.
videos.overview: The clock is ticking in the season finale which finds Loki and Sylvie on a date with destiny.

videos.title: Ouroboros
videos.overview: Loki finds himself lost to time and torn, quite literally, between past, present and future.

videos.title: Breaking Brad
videos.overview: With the TVA on the verge of a temporal meltdown, Loki & Mobius will stop at nothing to find Sylvie.
Loki & Mobius go on the hunt to find everyone’s favorite cartoon clock as they try to save the TVA.

videos.title: Heart of the TVA
videos.overview: The TVA's Loom nears catastrophic failure but Loki, Mobius and Sylvie have a He Who Remains variant.

videos.title: Science/Fiction
videos.overview: Loki traverses dying timelines in an attempt to find his friends, but Reality is not what it seems.

videos.title: Glorious Purpose
videos.overview: Loki learns the true nature of 'glorious purpose' as he rectifies the past.
